0022600191.text: The Knicks (4-4, 7th in the East) are 1-2 on the road and riding a two-game win streak, while the Cavaliers (4-4, 6th in the East) have lost their last two. Josh Hart is out for New York with an ankle injury, and Cleveland is without Jarrett Allen (knee) and Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain). New York has won every meeting in the 2025-26 season series, going 2-1 in the regular season and 4-0 in the playoffs, most recently a 130-93 victory in Cleveland on May 25, and the teams have not yet played each other in 2026-27.
